notes.title: Updates 25/02/21
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes – Improving the Experience for Casual Players[/h2]
After watching casual players try the game for the first time, I realized that many of them weren't having fun.
This could be due to the lack of a tutorial, poor UI/UX, or simply the game being unfamiliar to them.

Since my goal is to create a game where even players who aren’t familiar with FPS games can enjoy wiping out hordes of enemies, I saw that the current version wasn’t achieving that.

[h2]Changes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Reduced Enemy Wave Intensity – Fewer robots spawn per wave, making battles more manageable.
[*]  Weaker Elite Enemies – Reduced elite enemy health to make them less overwhelming.
[*]  Improved Guidance – Added visual indicators to help players know where to go.
[*]  Lobby Dummy NPCs – Added enemy dummies in the lobby so players can see what they’ll be up against.
[/list]

I hope this update makes the experience more enjoyable—let me know your thoughts!


---------------------------------------------------------------------------
I recognize that current version requires way too much VRAM and it often crashed loading map.
Later version i will try to reduce VRAM usage and make stable version.

notes.title: To Players
notes.content:
[h1]DontFallDown Demo – Development Update & Future Plans[/h1]
Hello everyone, and thank you for checking out the DFD Demo!

[h2]About the Demo’s Development[/h2]
This demo was developed between November 2024 and January 2025 as a solo project, meaning there are still plenty of bugs, rough edges, and unpolished mechanics. I recognize that the gameplay experience might feel unbalanced or chaotic, and I truly appreciate everyone who has taken the time to play and provide feedback.

[h2]Difficulty & Future Improvements[/h2]
One of the biggest things I’ve noticed from early player feedback is that the game is too difficult for casual players. While I wanted to create a challenging experience, I also want combat to feel fun, rewarding, and satisfying.
In future updates, I’ll be making adjustments to enhance the enemy-killing experience, ensuring that combat feels powerful and enjoyable while keeping the game challenging.

[h2]Development Break & Ongoing Updates[/h2]
I’ll be taking a short break until mid-March 2025 to rest and plan the next steps.
However, I will continue updating the demo over time until I feel the game’s overall structure is in a solid state.

[h2]Upcoming Features & Future Plans[/h2]
Here’s a glimpse of what’s coming in future updates:
✅ Ally AI System – Players will have up to three AI teammates to fight alongside them.
✅ Hero Progression – Heroes will gain items and skills to grow stronger over time.
✅ New Playable Heroes – More diverse hero options will be added in future builds.

[h1]Thank You for Playing![/h1]
This is just the beginning, and I sincerely appreciate everyone who has taken the time to try out the demo.
Your feedback is incredibly valuable and helps shape the future of the game.

Enjoy the demo, and I’ll see you all again in March!
